units.source_text: 我没有任何不安，没有任何门路，我从这里开始了独创的生活方式。

en.t: I had no anxiety at all, no path open to me, and from here I began an original way of life.

units.source_text: 这种问题会使人感到不安，甚至想要自杀。

en.t: Questions like that can make a person feel uneasy, even drive him to want to kill himself.

units.source_text: X型的腿是我生的条件、生的理由。

en.t: My X-shaped legs were the condition of my life, the reason for my living.

units.source_text: 生的目的和生的理想……这就是生的本身。

en.t: The purpose of life and the ideal of life... these were life itself.

units.source_text: 光存在这一点，对我就足够了。

en.t: The mere fact of existing was enough for me.

units.source_text: 本来所谓存在的不安，难道不正是由自己没有充分地存在这种过分的不清而产生的吗？

en.t: After all, is not the so-called anxiety of existence born precisely from the excessive uncertainty that one does not fully exist?
